## Análisis de los diamantes

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib
from ggplot import diamonds

matplotlib.style.use("ggplot")

print(diamonds.shape)
print(diamonds.head(10))
```

## Histograma

```{python}
diamonds.hist(column="carat", figsize=(8, 8), color="blue", bins=50, range=(0,3.5))
plt.show()
```

## Filtro de outliers

```{python}
print(diamonds[diamonds["carat"]>3.5])
```

## Boxplots

```{python}
diamonds.boxplot(column="price", figsize=(8, 8))
plt.show()
```

```{python}
diamonds.boxplot(column="price", by="clarity", figsize=(8, 8))
plt.show()
```

```{python}
diamonds.boxplot(column="carat", by="clarity", figsize=(8, 8))
plt.show()
```

## Densidades

```{python}
diamonds["carat"].plot(kind="density", figsize=(8, 8), xlim=(0, 5))
plt.show()
```

## Tabla de frecuencias y Barplot

```{python}
carat_table = pd.crosstab(index=diamonds["clarity"], columns="count")
print(carat_table)
carat_table.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(8, 8))
plt.show()
```

```{python}
carat_table_2 = pd.crosstab(index=diamonds["clarity"], columns=diamonds["color"])
print(carat_table_2)
carat_table_2.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(8, 8), stacked=True)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
carat_table_3 = pd.crosstab(index=diamonds["clarity"], columns=diamonds["color"])
print(carat_table_3)
carat_table_3.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(8, 8), stacked=False)
plt.show()
```

## Scatterplot

```{python}
diamonds.plot(kind="scatter", x="carat", y="price", figsize=(10, 10), ylim=(0, 20000), xlim=(0, 6), alpha=0.2)
plt.show()
```
